items.headline: Molecule acquires Trilogy to unify gas ETRM
items.summary: Molecule bought Trilogy Energy Solutions to merge physical natural gas operations with financial ETRM capabilities, targeting a single platform for producers, midstream and trading desks.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has extended roughly USD 1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders and signaled plans to scale this trade-finance lending further, per ICC Trade Finance Global.

items.headline: EMIR Phase II reconciliation moves ahead
items.summary: EU EMIR Phase II reconciliation, adding 61 new fields including valuations, started in April 2026 and the UK equivalent begins September 28, 2026, tightening trade-repository matching requirements for reporting desks.

items.headline: Container port rankings shift on Hormuz risk
items.summary: Ningbo-Zhoushan overtook Singapore as the world's second-busiest container port in H1 2026, while Dubai's Jebel Ali fell sharply amid Strait of Hormuz disruption, per U-Freight Group/FreightWaves data.
